_comment: Anti-vacuity baseline, keyed by repository-relative POSIX spec path. A suite that silently stops running tests must fail the build, so CI asserts the observed counts are at least these numbers. Every spec file the report mentions must appear here: a new spec is rejected until it is listed, so it cannot sit unprotected behind a healthy total. Raise a value when you add tests; lowering one needs justification in the PR body, because it is indistinguishable from tests quietly disappearing.
